arguments.message: pod reserve below 40 pct while still on the wash: decide let go

arguments.condition: elapsed_s >= 90 and push_local_mps - push_along_mps < 0.08 and empties_in_m_pod < remaining_m - maximum(300, 0.1 * remaining_m)
arguments.message: off the wash and the pod reserve runs out before the finish

text: no cue: on the wash with 92 pct pod reserve; hang on for now, pod watches set to call the let-go point

arguments.text: Let the pack go. Settle into your own steady pace.

text: let_go: wash nearly gone and holding the pack needs about 183 W shaft, well above the 171 W the pod reserve can hold to the finish

arguments.text: Ease a touch. Long way home, smooth steady effort.

text: ease: off the wash at 184-187 W shaft, pod reserve 62 pct and empties in 1.4 km of 6.7 km left; sustainable is about 170 W

arguments.text: Ease a little more. Settle at 2:42 pace into this current.

text: ease to 2:42: earlier ease only partial, shaft 178-182 W vs 170 W sustainable, pod reserve 51 pct empties in 2 km of 6.4 km

arguments.text: Forget the pace, current is stronger here. Ease off, steady by feel.

text: ease: shaft back up to 182 W chasing pace into a stronger local current, pod reserve 31 pct empties in 0.8 km of 5.6 km; effort must drop below 169 W
no cue: paddler eased to 173 W after the last cue (under a minute ago), close to the 168 W sustainable; let it settle after the turn

arguments.text: Ease off now, tank nearly empty. Lighter, smooth strokes.

arguments.message: about 450 m to go: decide the finishing sprint from the pod reserve

text: ease: pod reserve 9.5 pct empties in 400 m of 4.5 km at 176 W, sustainable 167 W, fade -4 pct shows real fatigue
no cue: eased to 168 W, at the 167 W sustainable level after the last cue; leave the paddler to settle

arguments.text: Out of the turn, ease back. Stay just under this effort.

arguments.message: fade persists after easing: consider a lower stroke rate

text: ease: 173 W out of the turn with pod reserve at 5.7 pct (empties in 330 m); must sit at or below 167 W to avoid blowing up
no cue: ease was cued seconds ago and effort is already falling (172 W); give it time to take effect

arguments.text: Little lighter again, then hold that. Do not blow up.

arguments.message: effort eased but fade persists: consider a lower stroke rate

text: ease: pod reserve 3.6 pct empties in 290 m at 171.5 W; effort must sit at critical power (166 W) to avoid a forced slowdown

arguments.text: Good effort. Lengthen out, drop the rate two, same effort.

text: rate_down: effort now at critical power (166 W) but speed at this rate is down several percent and lasting, a sign the rate is too high for a tiring paddler
no cue: rate cue given 30 s ago and still taking effect; re-check effort after the minute

arguments.text: Just a touch lighter. Steady to the last turn, then go.

text: ease: pod reserve reads empty with 172 W shaft vs 166 W critical power and 3 km left; speed holds so the calibration may be slightly low, but a small ease guards against a blow-up

arguments.message: 400 m to go, past the last turn: call the finishing sprint

text: no cue: holding about 170 W with steady speed for 8 minutes at a reserve the pod reads as empty, so this effort is sustainable; finish watch set at 400 m
no cue: 168-171 W held for 8 minutes with steady speed at a pod reading of empty; effort is sustainable, removed the watch that keeps firing on that reading
no cue: brief extra effort out of the turn; steady pacing has held for 9 minutes

arguments.text: Hold this effort, no harder. Sprint after the last turn.

text: hold: effort crept to 175-178 W after the turn and the fade is growing; hold about 171 W to the last turn and keep what is left for the sprint

arguments.message: 300 m to go: call the finishing sprint now

text: no cue: just out of the last turn with 500 m left and a tiring paddler; sprint called at 300 m

arguments.text: Three hundred to go. Everything you have left, go now.

text: finish: 293 m left; effort has dropped to 134 W so spend whatever remains in the final sprint
